		int u, v, f, c, nx;

		edge(int u, int v, int f, int c, int nx): u(u), v(v), f(f), c(c), nx(nx) {}
	} e[MAXE];

	bool _bfs() {
		static int q[MAXN], le, ri;
		le = ri = 0;
		memset(d, -1, sizeof(int) * n);
		q[ri++] = src;
		d[src] = 0;
		while(le < ri) {
			for(int k = q[le++], i = head[k]; i != -1; i = e[i].nx) {
				if(e[i].f < e[i].c && d[e[i].v] == -1) {
					d[e[i].v] = d[k] + 1;
					q[ri++] = e[i].v;
				}
			}
		}
		return (d[dst] != -1);

		if(u == dst)

			if(e[i].f < e[i].c && d[e[i].v] == d[u] + 1) {
